Bot: We can put that on hold for now. It seems like not many people noticed anything weird.
You: Really?
Bot: Most of the comments are focused on Annalie’s designs. 
Lady Annalie: I have no idea what you two are talking about, but if it means we can stay here for a bit longer, I’m all for it!
You: Then it’s settled. 
You: Just in case, get ready so that we can leave in a pinch.
Lady Annalie: Geez, are you two some kind of felons? I’m starting to get really concerned.
Bot: Well, we are not violent felons. I hope that puts you at ease.
#Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Suprised+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Hmm
Lady Annalie: N-Not really, but thanks for trying!
Lady Annalie: See you around guys! 
Bot: Bye!
